## Ownership And Temporal Cuts

- Complete-event executable fixtures prepare the original compiled source,
  native flow construction, source plan, process capability and issued grant
  before their first persisted delivery. Managed context comes from that grant,
  not a descriptive execution label. Historical claims occur after the real
  manager is running; backlog and post-election cases retain their later start.
  The original storage/recovery-only constructor remains unadmitted.
- The handoff seed returns its actual publication authority to its existing
  proof consumer. Explicit native actor setup precedes admission/publication;
  claims never construct actors or repair authority. Its genuinely issued
  selected execution remains separate and unchanged. Session binding consumes
  the already-prepared identity rather than rewriting it after claim.
- Duplicate-operation and standalone-final-receipt cases resolve descriptors
  before hashing and explicitly admit their prepared actor/source set. Original
  operation no-op, receipt cardinality and terminal-run checks remain.
- The filtered direct-recipient negative retains both original requester and
  wrong-target coordinates. Its source now declares those coordinates and
  constructs the requester through the existing flow owner, so the intended
  recipient refusal, not an earlier unknown-declaration error, is exercised.
  It gains no executable actor or admission.
- Persisted conformance proofs consume explicit native admission for complete
  turn/session/claim setup. The audit-only missing-session negative still runs
  before admission; public projection, no-promotion, stderr, exact frontier,
  lineage and replay aftermath assertions remain unchanged.
- Startup recovery claims work under the actually live predecessor grant,
  then retires/joins the predecessor before the successor starts. Fabricated
  predecessor labels cannot stand in for that execution cut. Recovery-disabled
  inventory prepares a native predecessor only for the future-failed/busy
  agent cases, claims/settles through that owner, releases it, then boots the
  successor. Pending, foreign-source, node and empty controls stay unchanged.
  All 48 cells retain exact no-delivery-mutation and pre-activation denial checks.
- Shutdown fixtures use the same native store for lifecycle, issued admission,
  configuration and delivery claims, plus the real manager readiness finalizer.
  The no-op manager persistence and identity-only readiness substitute are
  deleted after their last consumers move. Joined runtime cleanup is registered
  after capability setup and before materialization, unblocking held work before
  join and joining before capability release. Coordinator-before-manager
  teardown is retained on assertion failures.
- Managed channel transport explicitly admits its already-complete native
  actor/source setup. Its continuation surface uses the canonical projection
  against the issued grant while preserving callable tools and all source,
  actor, run, input, expiry, revocation and connector-generation negative cases.

No production admission fallback, Claim auto-heal, fake grant, selected-to-normal
conversion, timeout/budget increase, skip, retry-until-green or new accounting
exception is introduced. Successful reads, historical clocks and assertions
remain. This is fixture repair under the settled runtime contract, not a new
runtime contract requiring specification amendment.

the final 12-root bus receipt, rather than selecting away the failed cell.
